decision_required: Choose the source-general terminal taxonomy for a case with contradiction_count zero and a nonzero unsupported root count.

evidence.adjudicator_agreement: Both independent technical adjudicators classified the composite terminal label as TAXONOMY_AMBIGUITY.

options.text: Use a cause-specific label such as UNSUPPORTED_ONLY when contradiction_count is zero.
Retain CONTRADICTION_OR_UNSUPPORTED but require machine-readable active_reason values and root-versus-cascade counts.

question_for_human_expert: Must terminal labels name only causes observed in the case, or is a union label acceptable when its active branch is always explicit?
recommendation_basis: It prevents a zero-contradiction case from being read as evidence of contradiction and keeps terminal reporting aligned with the atomic root cause.
